additional_info.subject: ID0433419-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000691] Charger fan making noise due to heat CRM:02919000031
additional_info.body:
Hello Yacine, good afternoon.
I checked the charger now and it mentioned that the fan is running at 32% of total speed:
But as you can see there are some temperature sensors that register almost 50ºC. This could be the reason why it's running loud.
From the logs, everything looks ok. For us to check these logs, it needs to be recorded live as we need to enable Debug mode.
Please let me know your thoughts and questions.
Best regards,
Francisco
